scope: Tiny paired local contracts;root-owned runtime qualification is separate.

cases.title: Validate and canonicalize each raw microbatch
cases.input_contract: Require the explicit four-field schema, at most 8 rows and unique delivery IDs 1..12. Preserve NULL/business-invalid fields for classification and emit deterministic JSON.
cases.expected: BatchA has four occurrences with IDsA, B, A, NULL;NULL is preserved in canonical input. An oversized batch is rejected before collection.
cases.verification: Compare decoded delivery IDs 1..4 and the NULL marker;reject a12-row union.

cases.title: Implement the explicit state and lateness policy
cases.input_contract: Freeze cutoff at previous committed max_event_second minus 10. Validate domain, then classify existing equal ID payload as duplicate, conflicting payload as invalid, new old event as late, and remaining event as accepted.
cases.expected: AfterA:accepted 2, duplicate 1, late 0, invalid 1, total 30, max 105. An invalid far-future row does not advance max time.
cases.verification: Assert exact state and an invalid future control;preserve the original state value.

cases.title: Inject failure after publication but before query completion
cases.input_contract: Run the actual foreachBatch query with one injected exception after the atomic commit file becomes visible.
cases.expected: The query fails with injected_after_publication;commit 0 is readable and contains the correct first-state ledger.
cases.verification: Inspect the expected streaming exception, attempt 0 and unchanged source/checkpoint ownership.

cases.title: Replay the committed batch without applying it twice
cases.input_contract: Restart the same compatible query and checkpoint. Validate the existing batch input/content/chain and reuse its state.
cases.expected: Attempts 0,0 and callback rows 4,4;commit 0 bytes and logical state remain unchanged.
cases.verification: Compare query/run identities, exact bytes and all first-state counters.

cases.title: Process late, boundary, duplicate and conflicting events
cases.input_contract: PublishBatchB thenBatchC as separate immutable files and run each finite invocation against the same checkpoint.
cases.expected: Final accepted IDsA, B, D, E, F, total 75;duplicate 2, late 1, invalid 2;10 logical occurrences. Zero-valuedD and cutoff-boundaryF remain accepted.
cases.verification: Compare intermediateB counts and the final literal state;the high-timeE must not make same-batchD late.

cases.title: Hand off correctness, recovery and resource evidence
cases.input_contract: Return the exact final canonical state, record callback work 14 versus logical occurrences 10, and reject binding the existing sink to a different checkpoint.
cases.expected: Literal golden state matches;attempt IDs 0,0,1,2;callback rows 4,4,4,2;only owned inactive queries are eligible for cleanup.
cases.verification: Compare the complete state JSON and namespace-refusal negative;state the single-writer/local-filesystem limitations.

golden.policy: domain invalid;known equal duplicate;known conflicting invalid;new older than frozen previous_max-10 late;otherwise accepted
golden.state_scope: bounded application-managed state,not native Spark watermark/state eviction
golden.failure_point: after atomic publication before Spark completion
